contract.scope: Projects that publish source but no iOS artifact we could attribute and verify. A recipe is a review record — what to fetch, at which revision, with which digest, and which commands.
contract.provenance: Every recipe is pinned to a full commit SHA and carries the SHA-256 of the source archive downloaded at that revision, so a reviewer can prove the tree they build is the tree reviewed.
contract.signing: OmniSource does not sign, re-host, or distribute the output of a recipe. Signing stays with the builder's own Apple ID or certificate (AltStore, SideStore, Feather, TrollStore, a self-hosted SignTools). No recipe may fetch from, or point a build at, a host rejected by data/source_policy.json.
contract.excluded: Recipes that need a decrypted copy of someone else's App Store app as input are not recipes at all — that is the class data/source_policy.json rejects. .github/workflows/build-tweak.yml refuses such a base IPA before downloading it.
